prompts.title: 열린 저널 · Q / AI
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Asset: a refined square home-screen icon for "AI Tech Review Letters", an independent publication of quantum and AI lectures, scholarly reviews and technical journal articles.
Medium: elegant editorial watercolor plus precise typography. The mark should communicate quantum + AI + reading/review together with minimal elements.
Palette: keep very dark matte walnut/espresso brown background near #2F241E, subdued warm parchment/beige near #B39B79 and restrained patina teal near #6F9185. The background stays dark, never pale/orange. Slight wood-like warmth, no literal wood planks.
Texture and edge behavior: visibly more real watercolor than the reference. Dense crisp pigment at the structural edges should transition through granular translucent washes and feathered capillary bleeding into the dark background on one or two selected edges. Make the watercolor part of the actual mark, not a separate cloud/swoosh behind it. Keep the main silhouette confident and legible. One exceptionally subtle broad satin light glancing off a small upper part is allowed: barely perceptible, no star, sparkle, lens flare or metallic glare.
Typography: use exact capital Latin characters "Q" and "AI" wherever requested. Q must have a clear short tail; AI is capital A followed by capital I, not Al or Ai. Elegant slightly flared editorial typography with enough weight and spacing for a small icon, no hairlines. No additional words, fake body text, equations or decorative lettering.
Composition: a single centered mark with generous safe margins; opaque full-bleed square artwork, no rounded-square border baked in. No mockup, comparison sheet, heading or caption. Rounded masks will be applied later.
Avoid: atom orbit, brain, chip, robot, extra network nodes, stars, neon, chrome, embossed bevels, high gloss, dramatic vignette, surrounding objects, watermark.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the recognizable open journal's two page-outline silhouette, dark page interiors, slender teal central binding and spacious proportions. Set one large exact "Q" centered within the left page, and one balanced "AI" centered within the right page, like two restrained title initials. Match their visual weight and baseline; each occupies about half of its page's interior height. Keep whitespace around them and the binding. Enrich the lower-right page boundary's existing watercolor transition so a short section dissolves organically, with a few soft bleeds at the lower-left edge; use at most two connected strokes. The page structure remains clear. Very subtle satin sheen only at the upper page arc. Do not add closed-book depth.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: design-selected R formed from journal pages, with Q over AI inside its open counter. Make ONE restrained MATERIAL-ONLY refinement.
Keep the exact R silhouette, curves, folds, page-edge positions, proportions, negative space, teal underside shape, Q and AI letters, lettering size/placement/serifs/spacing, icon safe margins and dark walnut palette. Exact text must remain "Q" above "AI" (capital I). Do not add, remove, reposition or enlarge any symbol.
Change only the current crumpled/foil-like/built-up surface texture into refined FLAT WATERCOLOR PIGMENT. Beige is warm low-chroma parchment ink, not gold leaf. The marks should show delicate diluted color variation, translucent glazing, subtle capillary edges and a little pooled pigment on smooth cold-pressed paper. No embossed or crumpled-paper relief, thick impasto, glitter, metallic sheen, cracked foil or leather.
At the existing lower-right R ending, make the same existing boundary transition more genuinely watercolor: crisp dense pigment gradually becomes a light translucent wash with softly feathered wet edges, a few tiny granules, then gently disappears into the walnut ground. Keep the overall tail extent and direction, do not grow a smoke cloud or extra swoosh. The R's upper bowl and Q/AI remain crisp and readable; do not blur the whole icon.
Retain only an exceptionally faint broad satin light on a short upper curved edge, almost invisible. No visible glare hotspot, star or lens flare. Predominantly matte and quiet, with dark chocolate walnut, subdued parchment beige and patina teal.
Output one opaque full-bleed square icon only. No labels, frames, captions, other text, board or watermark.
